attributes.additional_details:
Major parties already have an advantage because of higher funds available.
This would even the playing field to the smaller parties to properly prepare to take on the giants.
If one of the major parties had received this large sum, would this be an issue.
Sadly democracy comes with a price tag, give all the parties a fighting chance.
Maybe reduce the amount given by tax payers to all parties, to help with the tax burden we are in now
attributes.background:
A lot in the News about Reform receiving a lot of Money. The Major parties received lots of money in the past. Now it is reform, there is an issue.
Donations should be whatever they want, to any party they want. As long as it is an unconditional donation. You can't change the law after the fact.

rejection.details: We find this petition unclear - we are not exactly certain what you are calling for it. For example what would even the playing field you refer to in the second paragraph?
